programme.title: The Great Elephant Tale
programme.desc: Documentary revealing how the African elephant has conquered the continent, following three vastly different herds - a matriarch leading her family across the merciless Namibian desert, a family protecting its young calf on the unforgiving planes of the Okavango Delta and a bull elephant searching for a mate along the immense Zambezi River.

programme.title: World's Most Toxic Animals
programme.desc: First of two programmes about some of earth's most dangerous creatures, which lurk in the oceans, the forests, swamps and deserts. In Australia, meet the world's most venomous snake, and in nearby oceans, discover the deadly nature of the marine creatures that share these tropical waters.

programme.desc: Exploring more of earth's dangerous creatures, beginning in the South American rainforest with the poison-packed golden dart frog, which harbours enough poison to kill 10 men. Plus, a visit to Sydney, Australia, home of the world's most venomous spider.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: Three lionesses go into labour, unaware that three rival lions are waiting across the river to oust the males, eat the newborn cubs, and take over the pride.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: The runt of a litter of lion cubs becomes separated from the pride, and would seem to be doomed - but the baby's mother responds to a cry for help and comes to the rescue.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue
programme.desc: Exploring New Zealand's marine wildlife, beginning with Snares Island in the southern Pacific and its crested penguins, petrels and sea lions.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue
programme.desc: The sea lions, albatrosses, red-billed gulls and fairy prions on New Zealand's Otago Peninsula find mates and nurture the next generation.

programme.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs
programme.desc: Documentary about dogs that help humans in surprising ways, including a Great Dane that has helped a 13-year-old girl with a muscle-wasting condition to walk, swim and even ride a bike. Plus, the stories of a Border collie mix who finds survivors during earthquakes, a labrador-German Shepherd mix who helps stop ivory poaching, and a team of water rescue dogs in Italy.

programme.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs
programme.desc: Looking at how a Sprocker spaniel's sense of smell and the protective instincts of an Anatolian shepherd dog are playing a vital role in the conservation of endangered species. Plus, a couple of canine colleagues who protect aircraft from potentially dangerous bird strikes during take-off and landing. Using their natural speed, stamina and desire to chase, the pair works at King Shaka Airport in Durban, South Africa, responding to emergency call-outs from air-traffic control.

programme.title: Extraordinary Animals
programme.desc: A look at some of the animals that take a playful approach to surviving Australia.

programme.title: Extraordinary Animals
programme.desc: A look at some of Australia's most sinister animals and the clever means of survival that lie behind each of these creatures' sinister traits.

This documentary follows the moose through the eyes of two yearlings as they are chased away from their mother before she gives birth to the next calf.

programme.title: Macaque Island

Matnoor rules over the 30 members of the Street troop, wihile Aarav is the old alpha male of the wilder Hill troop.

programme.title: Macaque Island
programme.desc: The Hill Troop invade the Street Troop's turf, before the Sisterhood plots to kidnap Sara's baby. Meanwhile, alpha Loci discovers his old rival is back.

programme.title: Macaque Island

programme.title: David Attenborough's Galapagos
programme.desc: The broadcaster explores the Galapagos, a collection of volcanic islands in the Pacific known for its extraordinary wildlife. More than 150 years after Charles Darwin formulated his ground-breaking theory of evolution on the remote archipelago, Attenborough explains how life on the islands has continued to evolve in biological isolation, examining how the ever-changing volcanic landscape has given birth to species and sub-species that exist nowhere else in the world. He begins by revealing how Galapagos rose from the ocean four million years ago.

programme.title: David Attenborough's Galapagos
programme.desc: The broadcaster reveals how life has learnt to adapt quickly in the ever-changing volcanic landscape, resulting in species that exist nowhere else in the world. David investigates the driving forces behind their evolution, exploring the appearance and behaviour of remarkable creatures and vegetation including giant whale sharks, marine iguanas and seemingly normal dandelion seeds that grow into plants the size of trees.

programme.title: David Attenborough's Galapagos
programme.desc: The broadcaster concludes his exploration of the archipelago with a look at how, despite their proximity, no two of the 19 islands are the same. He also uncovers evidence that evolution on Galapagos is occurring faster than Charles Darwin could ever have imagined, and encounters Lonesome George, the last remaining giant Pinta Island tortoise, who died just a few weeks after filming in June 2012.

programme.title: Violent Earth
programme.desc: How small fires become unstoppable megafires. Experts and survivors relive disasters including Yarnell Hill and Lahaina.

programme.title: David Attenborough's Rise of Animals: Triumph of the Vertebrates
programme.sub-title: From the Seas to the Skies
programme.desc: Part one of two. The naturalist explores the evolution of vertebrates over the past 500 million years, beginning with a look at how remarkable advances allowed primitive fish to make the radical move on to land, and then take to the skies with the advent of flight. He uses fossils of both ancient and living species combined with CGI and film to chart their journey out of the water to populate all corners of the globe.

programme.title: David Attenborough's Rise of Animals: Triumph of the Vertebrates
programme.desc: The naturalist concludes his two-part exploration of the evolution of vertebrates over the past 500 million years by looking at the history of mammals. He traces their journey from humble origins as tiny nocturnal forest-dwellers to their astonishing explosion in diversity and domination of the world following the death of the dinosaurs.

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough
programme.desc: The broadcaster continues his bug-eyed view of the world of creepy-crawlies, revealing how predators defuse the defences of their prey. Highlights include the cockroach wasp, busy preparing a tasty - and very live - treat for its young, the whirligig beetle, which employs a water-based radar system, and the jumping portia spider, which feeds on other arachnids.

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough
programme.desc: A further selection of creepy-crawly close-ups, focusing on courtship in the bug world. Highlights include scorpions shaking their booty, the perfume-wearing nasonia wasp and the tropical cricket, for whom romance goes out of the window as it uses bribery to seal the deal with would-be partners. One potential partner to steer well clear of, however, is the praying mantis, the female of which is notorious for eating the male just after - or even during - mating. Narrated by David Attenborough.

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough
programme.desc: A close-up view of sex, bug-style, as David Attenborough talks viewers through the different ways in which creepy-crawlies reproduce. Size matters for the minuscule male orb spider, creepily sneaking up on its intended and trying to mate without her noticing, while there's no rest for the lothario-like butterfly, which has plenty of notches on its proverbial bedpost. However, the harvestman spider has no use for sex at all, and reproduces by cloning itself.

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough
programme.desc: David Attenborough shifts the focus to bugs that prefer co-operation rather than conflict. They include burrowing cockroaches, the suitably named social spiders - which share a 30-metre web - the queen bee and her happy hive of workers and green ants pulling together to build a nest.

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough
programme.desc: The broadcaster concludes his close-up examination of the creepy-crawly world, shifting focus to the bugs' ultimate invention - the colony. Key residents of these minuscule mega-cities include honey bees, termites, leafcutter ants - who have a knack for farming - and their Argentine cousins, members of a community so vast it spans an entire continent.

programme.title: Vegas: The Story of Sin City
programme.desc: The history of Las Vegas through profiles of entertainers, entrepreneurs, the Mob and politicians over seven decades. The first edition reveals how the arrival of the Mafia and its money catapulted the city from a raffish frontier town to a glamorous entertainment destination featuring the biggest stars of the nightclub era.

programme.title: Dark Horses: Italy's World Cup Triumph
programme.desc: Fresh from a string of poor pre-tournament performances, Italy kickstart their World Cup out of favour, but advance from the group stage with relative ease.

programme.title: Lance
programme.desc: Part one of two. A personal examination of the rise and fall of Lance Armstrong. The programme examines the young Texan cyclist's rise to fame, his struggle with testicular cancer and subsequent emergence as a global icon with seven consecutive Tour de France titles, and his eventual downfall when he was revealed as being at the centre of one of the biggest doping scandals in sporting history.

programme.title: Lance
programme.desc: Part two of two. A personal examination of the rise and fall of Lance Armstrong. The series examines the young Texan cyclist's rise to fame, his struggle with testicular cancer and subsequent emergence as a global icon with seven consecutive Tour de France titles, and his eventual downfall when he was revealed as being at the centre of one of the biggest doping scandals in sporting history.

programme.title: The Directors
programme.desc: The life and work of Sidney Lumet, who was Oscar-nominated for his direction of 12 Angry Men, Dog Day Afternoon, Network and The Verdict.

programme.title: Discovering: Matthew McConaughey
programme.desc: A look at the life and career of the American actor, who starred in A Time to Kill, Magic Mike, Mud and The Wolf of Wall Street and won an Academy Award for Dallas Buyers Club.

programme.title: The Man Who Bought Cricket
programme.desc: The story of Allen Stanford's plan to revolutionise the game of cricket, which fell apart when he was exposed as a financial fraudster.

programme.title: David Frost Vs
programme.desc: Recalling some of the journalist's most famous interviews, beginning with his 1964 interview with Paul McCartney of the Beatles.

programme.title: The Body Next Door
programme.desc: Documentary about a mysterious death in the South Wales Valleys after the discovery of a body meticulously wrapped in over 40 layers of heavy-duty material. The story begins as what appears to be a seemingly harmless prank in the sleepy village of Beddau takes a horrifying turn when a medical skeleton is in fact revealed to be a dead body.

programme.title: The Body Next Door
programme.desc: A look at how South Wales police focused their attention on Leigh Sabine, an elderly woman with a deceitful past who had recently died of cancer. Shocking revelations about her five abandoned children and a 1960s manhunt in New Zealand emerged, exposing deep family secrets. As forensic officers raced to find evidence, the investigation uncovered a complex web of lies, leaving the village in turmoil.

programme.title: The Body Next Door
programme.desc: Leigh Sabine becomes the prime suspect when DNA links her to the body wrapped in plastic, but she flees to New Zealand with her son in pursuit, leading to deadly consequences. As the investigation unfolds, DCI Gareth Morgan races against time to determine the identity of the victim, piecing together a dark narrative of jealousy, control, and ultimate betrayal.

programme.title: Strange Journey: The Rocky Horror Picture Show
programme.desc: The origins and legacy of Richard O'Brien's cult musical, with contributions from the cast and crew of the 1975 film including Tim Curry, Susan Sarandon and O'Brien.

programme.title: QPR: The Four Year Plan
programme.desc: An insight into the running of Queens Park Rangers football club, as cameras were given unprecedented access to the boardroom and the first team. In 2007, the club was facing relegation from the Championship as well as financial ruin, before being bought by F1 supremo Bernie Ecclestone and Italian businessman Flavio Briatore. Soon after, they were joined on the board by Indian steel magnate Lakshmi Mittal, and together the new owners promised a return to glory for the club and its supporters.

programme.title: Pyaar Ka Safar
programme.desc: Bharath has lost everything since his childhood including his love. He is supported by his childhood friend Bhargava. Does Bhargava help him or will he end up destroying him completely.

programme.title: Drishyam
programme.desc: When the disappearance of a policewoman's son threatens to ruin Vijay's family, he leaves no stone unturned in order to shield his family.

programme.title: The Real Hunter
programme.desc: To fuel his political ambitions, Vijay's father fixes his marriage with an affluent girl. However, after Vijay falls for an ordinary villager and plans on marrying her, his father plans to stop him.

programme.title: Geet
programme.desc: After losing her ability to sing, Neha, a famous star, relocates to a small village. While she attempts to get back her voice, she encounters Rajesh, who decides to help her.

programme.title: Aakhri Ghulam
programme.desc: Bheema, his father Dinu and generations of their family have been slaves of the wealthy Thakurs. One day, he challenges their authority and invites trouble for himself in the process.

programme.title: Krishna Arjun
programme.desc: Sharda Yadav, a widow, lives with her two sons, Krishna and Arjun. Arjun is studying in Mumbai when he hears that his mother has passed away and Krishna has been arrested for raping a widow.

programme.title: Aar Ya Paar
programme.desc: Shekhar is having an affair with Anu, his wealthy wife's secretary. When the wife finds out, they kill her. The police then find evidence against him, and he learns that Anu is likely to betray him.

programme.title: Dhadkan
programme.desc: Anjali and Dev are in love with each other and plan to marry, but her family gets her married to Ram. Years later, Dev shows up to reunite with Anjali, however, she has fallen in love with Ram.

programme.title: Action Time
programme.desc: Vedha and his daughter Kanaka are on a killing spree. They are being chased by a cop Rama, but they always manage to escape in the nick of time. Can Rama stop the killings.

programme.title: 7th Day
programme.desc: When two friends run into David, an IPS official, they reveal an unfortunate event that changed their lives. David helps them get out of the mess but he is not what he claims to be.

programme.title: Blood Relation
programme.desc: Full of action and drama.

programme.title: Pyar Ki Kahani
programme.desc: Ram, a peon, forms a close friendship with a man named Ravi and values his opinion. However, he is shocked when Ravi disapproves of his fiancee and gets more upset when he learns the reason why.

programme.title: Gurudev
programme.desc: Inspector Dev Kumar has to choose between arresting his childhood friend Guru's father, who is a notorious criminal, and his integrity.

programme.title: Teri Kasam
programme.desc: Dolly, a rich and spoilt woman, falls for Tony, a poor musician, and marries him. However, her arrogance begins to create problems in their marital life.

programme.title: Keemat
programme.desc: Two crooks accidentally kill a man and decide to inform his parents about the bad news. However, once they meet the family, they end up lying to them.

programme.title: Jaan Se Pyaara
programme.desc: Inspector Jai arrests Guman only to release him after he threatens to destroy the city. Later, Jai's brother, who has a cognitive disability, gets abducted in return for a mysterious bag.

programme.title: Arundhati
programme.desc: An idol from a temple in Kshetram is hidden in a forest to protect it from invaders. The Rayulu family tries hard to reinstate it back to the temple in order to complete an old ritual.

programme.title: Market Raja MBBS
programme.desc: While in the pursuit of Raja, a ruthless don, the police accidentally kill Chandrababu, a medical student. Things take a turn when Chandrababu's spirit possesses Raja and turns him into a gentle soul.

programme.title: Kehte Hain Muzko Raaja
programme.desc: Action Movie.

programme.title: Aaj Ka Mahaatma
programme.desc: Randhir, a straightforward and hardworking man, sets out to avenge the death of his twin brother Ranvir, a criminal, who was murdered by a prison inmate.

programme.title: Laila
programme.desc: As a young boy, Deshraj was sent away for higher studies in order to protect him from a rival family's wrath. But upon his return, he falls in love with a girl who is the daughter of the same enemy.

programme.title: Hiraasat
programme.desc: ACP Ashok Saxena is an honest middle-class police officer who lives with his wife, Shobha, and college-going brother, Rajesh. However, he is framed in a case of drug-trafficking and gets arrested.

programme.title: Kaise Kahoon Ke...Pyaar Hai
programme.desc: Karan, a burglar, wishes to permanently leave his profession when he falls in love with Priya. They decide to get married, but Karan finds out that he has cancer.

programme.title: Barah Aana
programme.desc: Three men accidentally stumble into the world of crime when they start kidnapping for small ransoms in order to improve their lifestyles. However, they soon realise that it is not a bad business.

programme.title: Zakhmi Aurat
programme.desc: Inspector Kiran Dutt is brutally raped by Sukhdev and Suryakant. When they are acquitted by the court due to lack of evidence, she decides to take the law in her own hands.

programme.title: Biwi.Com

programme.title: David Attenborough and the Giant Elephant
programme.desc: Naturalist David Attenborough investigates the life of Jumbo, a famous Victorian elephant, supposedly the largest that ever lived. Jumbo arrived at London Zoo in 1865 and was popular with the royal family, but was dangerously unhappy in captivity. In later life, he would be sold to PT Barnum's circus, becoming a celebrity before dying under mysterious circumstances. Attenborough examines Jumbo's remains and considers the lives of elephants in the wild to learn more about the animal's difficult life.

programme.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
programme.desc: Frodo and Sam continue their quest to destroy the all-powerful ring, bringing them face to face with the magical artefact's twisted former owner Gollum. Meanwhile, their allies prepare to make a desperate last stand against the vast armies of the corrupted wizard Saruman, who has declared war on a neighbouring kingdom. Part two of Peter Jackson's fantasy adventure trilogy, starring Elijah Wood, Sean Astin, Viggo Mortensen, Ian McKellen, Billy Boyd, Dominic Monaghan, Andy Serkis and Christopher Lee.

programme.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
programme.desc: As hobbits Frodo and Sam near the end of their journey into the dark lands of Mordor to destroy the One Ring, the evil Sauron unleashes the full might of his armies on Middle-earth. Meanwhile, Aragorn must fulfil his destiny of becoming king by leading his people into a climactic battle with the forces of darkness. Conclusion of the fantasy adventure trilogy, starring Elijah Wood, Viggo Mortensen, Ian McKellen and Sean Astin.

programme.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
programme.desc: An unassuming hobbit is plunged into a battle against the forces of darkness when his uncle bequeaths him a magical ring of immense power. He joins a fellowship of heroes to embark on a perilous quest to destroy the ring before it falls into the hands of its creator - a dark lord who needs it to regain his power and conquer the world. The first part of Peter Jackson's epic fantasy trilogy based on JRR Tolkien's novel, starring Elijah Wood, Ian McKellen, Viggo Mortensen, Sean Astin, Christopher Lee, Liv Tyler and Orlando Bloom.

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: Teenager Sam Witwicky is treated to his first car by his dad, but it turns out to be an alien scout with a life of its own. Before long, the vehicle embroils Sam in a long-running intergalactic war between two factions of giant shape-changing robots, which have come to Earth to find a mystical cube that grants infinite power to its possessor. Michael Bay's sci-fi action adventure, inspired by the toy franchise, with Shia LaBeouf, Megan Fox, Josh Duhamel, Jon Voight and John Turturro.

programme.title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen
programme.desc: The war between the shape-shifting robots erupts once again, as the first of the evil Decepticons leads an attack on Earth to locate an ancient planet-destroying machine. Hapless teenager Sam Witwicky is caught in the middle of the ensuing conflict as he holds the key to discovering the location of the device. Sci-fi adventure sequel, starring Shia LaBeouf and Megan Fox.

programme.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
programme.desc: The heroic autobots discover that a spaceship from their own planet crashed into the moon decades ago, carrying their former leader and an incredibly powerful device. They must fight to defend the human race as their enemies the decepticons plot to use this machine to rebuild their own world and destroy the Earth. Sci-fi adventure sequel, with Shia LaBeouf, Josh Duhamel and Rosie Huntington-Whiteley.

programme.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction
programme.desc: The shape-changing robots are driven into hiding when the human race turns against them. When rediscovered by a kindly inventor and his daughter, they come out of exile to save the world, battling a new breed of human-created Transformers. These deadly new machines were created to hunt them down, but are now growing independent and intend to make use of technology from the Transformers' home planet in a plot that could threaten all life on Earth. Fourth film in the sci-fi adventure series, starring Mark Wahlberg, Stanley Tucci and Kelsey Grammer.

programme.title: Transformers: The Last Knight
programme.desc: The shape-changing robots and their human allies face a confrontation with their original creator, who has brainwashed their leader and intends to save her own home planet by destroying Earth. To save the human race they must recover an ancient artefact from Arthurian legend - but their mission is threatened by old enemies as they uncover a terrible secret about the history of the world. Sci-fi adventure sequel, starring Mark Wahlberg, Anthony Hopkins, Gemma Chan, Stanley Tucci and John Turturro.

programme.title: Bumblebee
programme.desc: In 1987, lonely Californian teenager Charlie Watson is traumatised by the death of her father and resentful of her mother Sally's relationship with new boyfriend Ronald. For her 18th-birthday she's given a yellow Volkswagen Beetle, which turns out to be the battle-scarred Autobot Bumblebee. Transformers prequel, starring Hailee Steinfeld, John Cena and Jorge Lendeborg Jr.
